    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    App
    The main entry point for the JavaFX application.
    CustomizeDrinkController
    Controller for customizing drink options such as sweetness and ice levels.
    DatabaseConnection
    Utility class for managing the database connection.
    DrinkItem
    Represents a customized drink item in the Boba Shop system.
    Employee
    Represents an Employee entity.
    EmployeeDAO
    Handles employee database operations such as retrieving, adding, and updating records.
    Inventory
    Represents a single inventory item in the boba shop.
    InventoryDAO
    Data Access Object for handling database operations related to Inventory items.
    InventoryManagerController
    Controller class for managing and displaying inventory items in the Boba Shop application.
    ManagerDashboardSimpleController
    Controller for the Manager Dashboard (manager-dashboard-simple.fxml).
    MenuDAO
    Data Access Object for handling all database operations related to MenuItems.
    MenuItem
    Represents an item on the menu with its details and availability.
    Order
    Represents an order in the Boba Shop system.
    OrderDAO
    Data Access Object for handling database operations related to Orders.
    OrderManager
    Manages the state of the current customer order using the Singleton pattern.
    OrderSummaryController
    Controller for the Order Summary modal dialog (order-summary.fxml).
    PosMainController
    Controller for the main POS interface.
    ReportsDAO
    Handles generating daily reports from the database, including orders, revenue, and inventory data.
    SalesAnalysisDAO
    Data Access Object for performing sales analysis.
    XReportDAO
    Data Access Object for generating X-Reports (hourly sales summaries).
    XReportEntry
    Represents a single row of data for an X-Report (hourly sales summary).
    ZReportDAO
    Data Access Object for generating Z-Reports (end-of-day sales summaries).
    ZReportEntry
    Represents a single row of data for a Z-Report (end-of-day summary).
